about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Who I Am
about.p1: Motivated Full-Stack Web Developer with hands-on experience building responsive and database-driven web applications using Laravel, PHP, JavaScript, React, and MySQL.
about.p2: Experienced in developing e-commerce platforms, authentication systems, RESTful API integrations, and scalable CRUD applications. Strong understanding of both front-end and back-end development with a focus on clean architecture, responsive UI, and performance optimization.
about.p3: Passionate about building modern web applications and continuously improving technical skills. When I'm not coding, you'll find me exploring new technologies and contributing to developer communities.

items.title: Todo-App

items.title: Clinic Website
items.description: A modern and responsive clinic website template built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript featuring a clean medical-style interface.

Built and maintained 6+ responsive websites and web applications using Laravel, PHP, JavaScript, Bootstrap, and MySQL. Developed dynamic full-stack applications with database integration and authentication systems.
Managed and updated website content using WordPress CMS. Applied SEO best practices to improve website visibility and structure. Maintained content accuracy, consistency, and site usability.
